## What's Changed
* ci: drop the provenance-landed assertion by @alikhan126 in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/18
* fix: tell the agent TLS trust is preconfigured, so it stops prefixing commands by @alikhan126 in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/20
* feat: `veris-daytona run` — the SDK as one command, with a receipt-gated exit code by @ritiztambi in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/19
* docs: point at @veris-ai/veris-sim-opencode, the renamed veris-sim plugin by @alikhan126 in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/22
* fix: trust Node via NODE_OPTIONS=--use-openssl-ca, since Daytona overwrites the CA variables by @alikhan126 in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/21
* chore: drop CHANGELOG.md, the GitHub release notes are the changelog by @alikhan126 in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/23
* fix: run exports the Veris trust variables on every command, since Daytona overwrites them by @ritiztambi in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/24
* fix: fit Daytona's 20-domain allowlist, allow the twin's own host, and read the whole receipt by @ritiztambi in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/25
* fix: delete the sandbox a failed create left behind, and say why it failed by @ritiztambi in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/27
* feat: `provision` and `teardown` — hand a wired sandbox over, and take it back by @ritiztambi in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/26
* chore: land provision, teardown and the failed-create fixes on main by @ritiztambi in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/28
* feat: `push` and `exec` — get code into a provisioned box, and run things in it by @ritiztambi in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/29
* fix: read the CLI's login profile, and say why a teardown was refused by @alikhan126 in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/30
* fix(opencode): correct session and receipt guidance by @alikhan126 in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/31
* feat: add run-scoped receipts and session controls for skills by @alikhan126 in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/36
* fix: pin Daytona to the gateway address, since a domain allowlist turns on TLS inspection by @vcshih in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/38

## New Contributors
* @ritiztambi made their first contribution in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/19
* @vcshih made their first contribution in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/38

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0

- https://www.npmjs.com/package/@veris-ai/daytona/v/0.2.1
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/@veris-ai/daytona-opencode/v/0.2.1

- **`NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` now points at the merged bundle, not the lone Veris
  cert.** That variable extends Node's *baked-in Mozilla roots*, never the
  system store — and the leaf Node actually validates in a Daytona sandbox is
  signed by Daytona's proxy CA, which lives only in the system store. So with
  the single-cert file, every Node HTTPS call to a vendor host failed with
  `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE`, and agents in the sandbox learned to
  compensate by prepending `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/tmp/veris-ca-bundle.crt` to
  every command by hand. Every other trust variable already pointed at the
  bundle (system store — Daytona's CA with it — plus ours); Node's was the one
  exception, and now it isn't. Plain `node` works in a fresh sandbox, no flag,
  no prefix.

## What's Changed
* fix: point NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS at the merged bundle by @alikhan126 in https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/pull/17


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/veris-ai/veris-daytona/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
